term: intrinsic sources receive no per se link
definition: `SourcesReceiveNoLink R src`: no being R-relates to an intrinsic source, i.e. nothing causes a source as a caused cause.
note: An analyst's condition used only as an antecedent of GROUNDING-WITH-UNIQUE-CAUSE-YIELDS-REGRESS-READING. Compare UnborrowedPowerAt (DEF-UNBORROWED-POWER-IN-A-RESPECT), which says the same of transmission at one world. Sourcing it would need a passage on the first cause as uncaused in the relevant respect.
